facts.text: Deborah traveled to Bali last year and found it to be a peaceful place for yoga.

evidence.quote: I've been blessed to travel to a few places and Bali last year was one of my favs. It was a gorgeous island that gave me peace, great for yoga.

facts.text: Deborah mentioned that the sound of the waves and fresh air in Bali were wonderful.

evidence.quote: The sound of the waves and the fresh air is wonderful!

facts.text: Jolene expressed interest in trying yoga on the beach after hearing about Deborah's experience in Bali.

evidence.quote: Is yoga on the beach a thing? I've been wanting to try it.

facts.text: Jolene confirmed her intention to try yoga on the beach and thanked Deborah for the suggestion.

evidence.quote: I'll definitely give it a go! It sounds peaceful. Thanks!
